description: Single-panel chart containing many filled circles scattered across the main plotting region; circles vary in size and are uniformly colored. No other data-encoding layers (no lines, bands, or areas). Legend and axes are excluded.

primary.explanation: Bubble scatter plot with many circles positioned by both x and y; approximate count of points.

secondary.explanation: Each point also has a y position.
